output_rules.format: one JSON object only, with no Markdown fence or prose

evidence_shape.line_start: integer within core or permitted context
evidence_shape.line_end: integer within core or permitted context
evidence_shape.excerpt: nonempty verbatim text from assigned excerpt

output_rules.exact_evidence_refs: deduplicated list containing every nested evidence ref
output_rules.no_finding_behavior: return an empty candidate_findings array and use explicit_non_gaps or unknowns
output_rules.repair_recommendations: forbidden beyond describing the missing or underspecified contract
output_rules.exact_reviewer_conclusions: must not be inferred or mentioned

infrastructure_failure_rule: If the capsule or source excerpt hash or byte size mismatches, return status infrastructure_failure, keep substantive arrays empty, describe only the mismatch in unknowns, and perform no semantic review.
